data.one_liner: Customizable alert and popup dialogs for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display alert dialogs with titles, descriptions, custom images, and any number of buttons. Allows extensive styling, animation types, and overlay behavior. Can be invoked with a simple .show() call.
use_when: You need a quick, reusable custom dialog with multiple buttons
You want custom animations or styles beyond the default Material dialog
You prefer an API that shows the dialog imperatively
avoid_when: You need a full dialog management system or routing integration
You are building a large UI kit where a more comprehensive solution is preferred
strengths: Supports unlimited buttons and custom content
weaknesses: Focused only on alerts, not a full dialog framework
May not match native platform dialog conventions
Last update was in 2023, may lack newer Flutter features
data.minimal_example: Alert(context: context, title: "RFLUTTER", desc: "Flutter is awesome.").show();
